target_field_or_claim: Equity liquidation order generation for held positions rated SELL or AVOID
erroneous_value: The order builder inspects held equity positions only to write covered calls, and only where the rating is BUY or HOLD and the lot is at least 100 shares. `SELL` and `AVOID` ratings trigger a BUY TO CLOSE order for short option positions but there was no code path that emitted a sell order for held common stock. A portfolio whose every holding was rated SELL or AVOID generated zero orders.
corrected_value: RESOLVED 2026-08-28. Added a SELL TO CLOSE liquidation step to `build_plan_orders_for_account`, sequenced after the BUY TO CLOSE option step (so share locks are released first) and before the covered call and cash-secured put steps. Emits a marketable limit 3% through the mark for single-session fill, sub-penny tick precision below $1.00, whole-share limit plus fractional market-order remainder, a cross-reference when the underlying carries an open short option, and treats sale proceeds as T+1 unsettled so they are not double-counted as same-session put collateral.
authoritative_source_citation: Direct execution of `scripts/generate_plan.py` against `private/snapshots/2026-08-28-ira-positions.csv`; source inspection of `build_plan_orders_for_account` confirming SELL/AVOID handling is gated on `contracts < 0`
